entries.uk: Я чув, що в підземному торговому центрі[n]є квіткова крамниця. Ходімо глянемо.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! We're gonna go buy flowers,[n]aren't we?
entries.uk: Агов! Ми ж ідемо купувати квіти,[n]хіба ні?

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Oh, [lName]-kun? What brings you[n]here today?
I'm here for a gift.
I'm here for a surprise present.

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: I see! Okay, leave it to me!

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: That should do it. I tried to keep it as[n]simple as possible.
entries.uk: Ось, готово. Я постаралася зробити[n]якомога простіше.

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Okay, that comes out to...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on! Let me cover this one. You've[n]been taking care of me yourself, so...
entries.uk: Стривай! Дай-но я заплачу. Ти ж сам[n]весь цей час про мене дбав, тож...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I need to express appreciation for[n]you, too.
entries.uk: Мені теж треба висловити тобі вдячність.

entries.speaker: Hanasaki
entries.en: Good luck! I'm rooting for you!

entries.speaker: Female Shop Worker
entries.en: Welcome! What kind of flowers are[n]you looking for today?
entries.uk: Вітаємо! Які квіти ви шукаєте сьогодні?

entries.en: I'm here for a gift.
I'm here for a surprise present

entries.speaker: Female Shop Worker
entries.en: Understood. I'll get right on that.

entries.speaker: Female Shop Worker
entries.en: Here you go! I tried to keep it as simple[n]as possible.

entries.speaker: Female Shop Worker
entries.en: The total comes out to...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on! Let me cover this one. You've[n]been taking care of me yourself, so...
entries.uk: Стривай! Дай-но я заплачу. Ти ж сам[n]весь цей час про мене дбав, тож...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I need to express appreciation for[n]you, too.
entries.uk: Мені теж треба висловити тобі вдячність.

entries.speaker: Female Shop Worker
entries.en: Thanks for your purchase. Good luck!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's it! The gift is ready!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, now you're all ready for the date.[n]You know who you plan on inviting...[n]right?
entries.uk: Гаразд, тепер ти готовий до побачення.[n]Ти ж знаєш, кого збираєшся запросити...[n]правда?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't worry, I'm a gentleman who[n]knows his manners. I won't be tagging[n]along.
entries.uk: Не хвилюйся, я джентльмен і знаю, що таке[n]гарні манери. За тобою не ув'язуватимусь.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, good luck out there!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Heeey! What's up?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What? Something wrong?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sorry, I'm at the school right now...[n]What do you need?
entries.uk: Вибач, я зараз у школі...[n]Що ти хотів?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes...?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, [lName]-san? Is something[n]wrong?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey you. What's going on?
entries.uk: Агов, ти. Що там у тебе?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey. What's up?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: [fName]? Is something wrong?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: [fName]-kun? Is something the[n]matter?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Yes, Yoshizawa speaking.
I want you to come to Shinagawa.
Let's go to Shinagawa.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Right now? Just like that?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, what my boyfriend wants, he gets![n]Lemme finish up work and I'll get going.
entries.uk: Ну, чого мій хлопець хоче, те й отримує![n]Дай закінчу з роботою — і вирушаю.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Shinagawa? Why? Well, I guess that's[n]a stupid question...
entries.uk: До Шінаґави? Навіщо? Хоча, мабуть,[n]дурне запитання...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm at work, but I can take off early.[n]I'll see you there.
entries.uk: Я на роботі, але можу піти раніше.[n]Побачимося там.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Right now? That's kind of sudden.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But sure. I'm almost done with work,[n]so I can head over.
entries.uk: Але гаразд. Я майже закінчила роботу,[n]тож можу приїхати.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: To... Shinagawa?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Sure... Let me get my things, and I'll[n]head over.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'll see you later...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Shinagawa? Sure...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'll close up early so I can go.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Shinagawa...? O-Okay, I guess.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Are you out right now? Could you come[n]get— Uh... never mind. I can meet up[n]with you there.
entries.uk: Ти зараз не вдома? Можеш заїхати[n]по... Е-е... забудь. Зустрінемося[n]вже там.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Alrighty, see you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shinagawa? Okay, sure.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And it just happens to be on White Day,[n]huh? I've actually been kinda looking[n]forward to this.
entries.uk: І якраз на Білий день, га? Чесно кажучи,[n]я цього трохи чекала.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, let me get ready and I'll head over.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? Um... okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank god you said something. I was[n]getting kind of worried. Today's, well...[n]you know.
entries.uk: Слава богу, що ти озвався. Я вже почала[n]трохи хвилюватися. Сьогодні ж, ну...[n]сам знаєш.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay. Let me get changed, and I'll meet[n]you there.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: To Shinagawa? Ah... Sure.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So... It's a date, then! I'd be happy to.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Okay, let me go get ready. I'll meet you[n]there?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Right now? Of course, that's fine!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I don't have practice today, so I'll head[n]over right away.
entries.uk: У мене сьогодні немає тренування,[n]тож вирушаю негайно.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: See you there!
I should get ready to[n]head to Shinagawa...
I should return to Leblanc...

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: The lucky bags here are suppose to be[n]amazing. I heard they're worth 10 times[n]what it costs to buy them!
entries.uk: Кажуть, щасливі пакунки тут просто[n]неймовірні. Я чула, що вміст удесятеро[n]дорожчий за ціну!

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: I guess everyone's heard, there are so[n]many people.
entries.uk: Мабуть, усі про це чули — он скільки[n]людей.

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Although I do suspect some people[n]plan on selling what they get.
entries.uk: Хоча підозрюю, що дехто збирається[n]перепродати те, що дістанеться.

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Yeah, it's crazy how many people there[n]are! But I really want to get one!
entries.uk: Так, людей просто шалена кількість![n]Але я дуже хочу такий пакунок!

entries.en: The line seems to be for the lucky bags.
entries.uk: Схоже, це черга по щасливі пакунки.

entries.en: I don't think I can go in any further...
